adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and, when a matching credential is not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` inside the loop (EventManager.ts around the added block in that loop). Because this is awaited per destination, it can create an N+1/sequential DB round-trip pattern when multiple destination calendars are present. This is a concrete performance/architecture issue introduced by the change, not an immediate correctness defect.
